Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_prod_count number;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

--For manual entry of product code check the length of product code
IF :s_product_code = 'M' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' AND NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code), 0) != 8 THEN
 show_error_dist('9803');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' AND NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code), 0) != 5 THEN
 show_error_dist('9804');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
END IF;
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_prod_count
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code), 0),5,'C','I');

 if temp_prod_count = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('0309');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct c.product_code,v.product_short_name
 into :ctrl_blk_1.product_code,:ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code_desc
 from components c, vserv_products v
 where c.unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id 
 and v.product_code = substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code, 1, 5) 
 and c.component_prefix = substr(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code, -2) -- Added by Kishore on 07/01/2014. IM 10063
 and substr(c.product_code,1,5) = v.product_code 
 and v.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme;
/* Commented by sobha PR. 001.032321 AND
 sysdate between v.eff_date and nvl(v.term_date, sysdate+365);*/
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error_dist('0309');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select aliquot into :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot
 from active_products
 where
 unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 --Following if condition added for both schemes 
 IF NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code), 0) = 5 THEN 
 :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot := 1;
 ELSE 
 :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot := '00';
 END IF;
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select aliquot into :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot
 from shipped_products
 where
 unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 --Following if condition added for both schemes 
 IF NVL(length(:ctrl_blk_1.product_code), 0) = 5 THEN 
 :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot := 1;
 ELSE 
 :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot := '00';
 END IF;
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select aliquot into :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot
 from discard_products
 where
 unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS then
 :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot := 1;
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error_dist('0309');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 ap_count number;
 dp_count number;
 sp_count number;
 cursor c1 is
 select attrib_group, attrib_code
 from unit_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 union
 select attrib_group, attrib_code
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code
 order by 1,2;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select count(*) into ap_count
 from unit_antigens
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if ap_count > 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.antigens := 'Y';
 go_block('unit_antigens');
 :system.message_level := '25';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 else
 :GLOBAL.antigens := 'N';
 end if;
 end;
 begin
 go_block('ctrl_blk_2');
 :GLOBAL.attributes := 'N';
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :ctrl_blk_2.attrib_group := c1_rec.attrib_group;
 :ctrl_blk_2.attrib_code := c1_rec.attrib_code;
 :GLOBAL.attributes := 'Y';
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 end;
 select count(*) into ap_count
 from active_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 aliquot = :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if ap_count > 0
 then
 go_block('active_products');
 :system.message_level := '25';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 else
 select count(*) into dp_count
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 aliquot = :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if dp_count > 0
 then
 go_block('discard_products');
 :system.message_level := '25';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 else
 select count(*) into sp_count
 from shipped_products
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 product_code = :ctrl_blk_1.product_code and
 aliquot = :ctrl_blk_1.aliquot and
 stock_state in ('SH', 'DL', 'RT') and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if sp_count > 0
 then
 go_block('shipped_products');
 :system.message_level := '25';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 else
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 previous_item;
 END IF;
 show_error_dist('0313');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_unit_id VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_v_item1 varchar2(60); --For returning Checkdigit 
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 IF :GLOBAL.chk_digit != '-*' THEN
 show_error_dist('1230');
 check_package_failure; 
 END IF;
 temp_v_item1 := substr(:GLOBAL.field_left,1,instr(:GLOBAL.field_left,'.')) ||
 get_item_property(:GLOBAL.field_left, nextitem);
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id || 
 lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0') ||
 substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,1,6);
 --:GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,8,1);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := substr(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no,7,2); 
 
 copy(:GLOBAL.chk_digit, temp_v_item1); 
 ELSIF :GLOBAL.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 copy('', temp_v_item1); 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 temp_v_unit_id varchar2(17) := ltrim(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id) ||
 ltrim(lpad(to_char(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year),2,'0')) ||
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 temp_v_unit_serial_no varchar2(11) := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no ; 
 temp_v_out_unit_id varchar2(15) := null;
 temp_v_out_chk_digit varchar2(2) := null; 
BEGIN
 default_value(NULL,'GLOBAL.unit_serial_no') ; 
 IF (NVL(length(temp_v_unit_serial_no), 0) in ('7','10') or :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL) 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id IS NULL 
 AND :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year IS NULL
 THEN
 -- Assume it to be a CODABAR unit.
 IF :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF temp_v_unit_serial_no = :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no THEN
 Validate_Unit_Scan_Codabar(temp_v_unit_id,'M','C',temp_v_out_unit_id);
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.manual_unit_id := temp_v_out_unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL; 
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'C';
 :GLOBAL.coll_id := null;
 :GLOBAL.coll_year := null;
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := null;
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left); 
 ELSE
 IF NVL(length(:manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no), 0) != 
 NVL(length(:GLOBAL.unit_serial_no), 0) THEN
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0049');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.chk_digit := NULL;
 :GLOBAL.code_scheme := 'I';
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := NULL;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no := ''; 
 show_error_dist('0045');
 check_package_failure;
 go_item(:GLOBAL.field_left);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :GLOBAL.unit_serial_no := :manual_unit_entry_coexist.unit_serial_no;
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_id := NULL; 
 :manual_unit_entry_coexist.coll_year := NULL;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_AG_CODES_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_ag_codes_info(unit_id_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 go_block('ag_codes_info');
 
 clear_block(no_validate);
 
 first_record;
 
 
 FOR rec IN ( SELECT
 ag_hdr.antigen_code, ag_hdr.confirm_flag
 FROM
 ag_donor_tests_hdr ag_hdr, donations dn
 WHERE
 ag_hdr.donor_id = dn.donor_id
 AND dn.unit_id = unit_id_in)
 LOOP
 
 :ag_codes_info.antigen_code := rec.antigen_code;
 :ag_codes_info.confirm_flag := rec.confirm_flag;
 
 next_record;
 
 END LOOP;
 
 first_record;
 

END;

declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
